checks.rule: Ground-truth sites use flat unambiguous surfaces such as tarmac or tennis courts
Each ground-truth point accuracy is +/-3cm RMSE
Ground-truth attributes include survey date and surface type
Transformation and geoidal models used are recorded
Ground truth may be reused only while under 5 years old for non-coastal work
Coastal ground truth age limit is 3 years
LIDAR timestamped survey must be under +/-15cm RMSE to pass QC
EA ground-truth dataset states 10cm standard-deviation and random-error QC limit
EA FAQ separately states expected relative height error no more than +/-5cm
QC metric provenance must be preserved rather than merging differing specifications into one invented tolerance
